mootSayLines.text: Word reaches you, days late: Vera stands accused over what happened to Tom. There's going to be a moot. People are choosing sides.
🔴 LIVE! THE MOOT! The fire's built HIGH and the whole GALAXY is watching!
You call a moot. The fire gets built up. Word travels fast — almost everyone comes, even the ones who'd rather not.
The moot turns to you. Your vote matters here — and everyone will remember it.

🔴 LIVE! THE MOOT! The fire's built HIGH and the whole GALAXY is watching!
You call a moot. The fire gets built up. Word travels fast — almost everyone comes, even the ones who'd rather not.
The moot turns to you. Your vote matters here — and everyone will remember it.
At the moot, you lay it out: who paid whom, what changed hands. The fire goes very quiet. Nobody likes being bought — least of all the ones who weren't.
They're named, every one: Elena Okafor, Theo Park, Alba Ibrahim. Your move — ask them questions (up to three), call a MOOT on it, or turn them away at the edge of the firelight.
They waited three days at the edge of your fire. Nobody called the moot. Elena nods — not angry, just done — and they walk.
